sentences.zh: 我想说 ChatGPT 的发展真正始于 2017 年，当时谷歌的研究人员

sentences.zh: 所以有很多方式可能会对劳动力市场造成这种冲击。

sentences.en: I don't think any of them are so immediate that we need to start worrying about them right this minute.
sentences.zh: 我不认为其中任何一种冲击是如此迫在眉睫，以至于我们需要现在立刻开始担心。

sentences.en: But I do think it's a valid concern that will definitely become more urgent in the coming years.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为这是一个合理的担忧，在未来几年里肯定会变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: Okay, let's turn to what chat GPT says is the next big downside of its very existence.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们来看看ChatGPT认为它自身存在的下一个重大负面影响是什么。

sentences.en: And it describes that as bias and discrimination and says that AI systems, and I find this wording
sentences.zh: 它将其描述为“偏见与歧视”，并表示人工智能系统——我觉得这种用词

sentences.en: really interesting, are only as fair and unbiased as the data that they are trained on.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣，只有在它们所依据的数据一样公平且不偏不倚时，它们才同样公平公正。

sentences.en: I mean, how do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你是怎么看待这个问题的？

sentences.en: How should we be thinking about that?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何看待这件事？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a really important question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: And AI experts and researchers and ethicists have been bringing this up for many years about these transformer large language models.
sentences.zh: 人工智能专家、研究人员和伦理学家多年来一直在讨论这些Transformer大语言模型带来的这个问题。

sentences.en: They do reflect and perpetuate the biases of the data that they're trained on.
sentences.zh: 它们确实反映并延续了它们所训练的数据中的偏见。

sentences.en: So a large language model that is asked to answer the question, for example, what was the cause of the Civil War, is going to answer
sentences.zh: 因此，如果要求一个大语言模型回答这个问题，比如美国内战的原因是什么，它的回答将会...

sentences.en: that question very differently if it's trained on, you know, conservative textbooks that are taught
sentences.zh: 如果它是根据，你知道的，美国深南州学校教授的保守派教科书，

sentences.en: in schools in the Deep South versus, you know, the work of left-leaning progressive historians.
sentences.zh: 而不是，你知道的，左翼进步派历史学家的著作进行训练的，那么它给出的答案将会大不相同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's also kind of these latent biases that might not be obvious for people using most of these chat bots, but that might surface at inopportune moments.
sentences.zh: 还有一些潜在的偏见，使用大多数这些聊天机器人的人可能不会察觉，但它们可能会在不合时宜的时刻浮现出来。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: Well, it might be that if you say, you know, write me a love story as you did earlier in this episode...
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能是如果你说，你知道的，像你在这期节目早些时候那样，为我写一个爱情故事……

sentences.en: Right, Jack and Jill.
sentences.zh: 没错，杰克和吉尔。

sentences.en: It uses Jack and Jill.
sentences.zh: 它用了杰克和吉尔。

sentences.en: It uses a heterosexual, presumably heterosexual male-female couple as the main characters in that story.
sentences.zh: 它把异性恋，大概是异性恋的男女伴侣作为那个故事的主角。

sentences.en: Right, as the archetypes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，作为原型，完全是这样。

sentences.en: And presumably that's because of the many, many millions of love stories that were fed into this model to train this chat bot.
sentences.zh: 想必这是因为有成千上万个爱情故事被输入到这个模型中来训练这个聊天机器人。

sentences.en: A majority or vast majority of them featured heterosexual male-female couples.
sentences.zh: 其中绝大多数或绝大多数都是以异性恋男女伴侣为主角的。

sentences.en: So that is an example where, you know, this machine, which isn't making any moral or ethical
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个例子，你知道的，这个机器本身并不做任何道德或伦理上的...

sentences.en: judgments of its own, is simply regurgitating a sort of statistical average of everything that it has learned about human love stories.
sentences.zh: 它没有做出自己的判断，只是简单地重复了它所了解到的关于人类爱情故事的一切的统计平均值。

sentences.en: And that just happens to perpetuate this kind of heteronormative, you might say, ideal.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好延续了这种，你可以说，所谓的异性恋规范的理想。

sentences.en: So I think that for all of these reasons, the questions about bias and stereotypes and the various training that goes into these models are going to be very controversial
sentences.zh: 所以我认为出于所有这些原因，关于偏见、刻板印象以及输入这些模型的各种训练的问题将非常具有争议性，

sentences.en: and very heated as these programs move toward the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 随着这些程序走向主流，这也将成为一个高度激烈的话题。

sentences.en: Okay, so the next liability pitfall worry I want to bring up is not one that the chat bot raised,
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我想提出的下一个责任陷阱和担忧，并不是聊天机器人提出的，

sentences.en: but it's one that you and I have talked about a lot when we talk about technology, which is,
sentences.zh: 而是你和我每次讨论科技时经常谈到的一点，那就是：

sentences.en: isn't there pretty obvious risk that over time, a technology like this essentially is used for ill?
sentences.zh: 难道不存在一个非常明显的风险，即随着时间的推移，像这样的技术本质上会被用于作恶吗？

sentences.en: You know, it becomes a tool by which users manipulate it and turn it into a source of misinformation, of hate.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它成了一种工具，用户可以操纵它，把它变成虚假信息和仇恨的源头。

sentences.en: I mean, that is kind of the story of every major social network and platform that has been created over the past 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，过去20年里创建的每一个主流社交网络和平台，几乎都是这样的故事。

sentences.en: Is that a worry that people who make this bot have that you have?
sentences.zh: 制作这个机器人的那些人，以及你，会有这样的担忧吗？

sentences.en: Or is there something in the design that makes you not as worried as you might normally be about it?
sentences.zh: 还是说它的设计中有什么东西让你不像平时那样为此感到担忧？

sentences.en: No, I think it's very reasonable to be worried about.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为这种担忧是非常合理的。

sentences.en: And I think that's a larger worry about these systems is that they are just extremely efficient at generating large amounts of output very, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对这些系统更深层的担忧在于，它们在极短时间内生成大量输出时效率极高。

sentences.en: So, you know, think about how quickly propaganda and misinformation are created today and how hard it is for fact checkers to keep up with it in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以想想，今天宣传和虚假信息产生得有多快，事实核查员实时跟进它们有多难。

sentences.en: And now imagine an
sentences.zh: 而现在想象一下

sentences.en: AI model that is capable of generating not just one piece of propaganda, but 100,000 pieces that are
sentences.zh: 这样一个AI模型，它不仅能够生成一条宣传信息，还能生成十万条，

sentences.en: tailored to maybe individual readers and doing that all in real time much faster than any human fact checker or opponent of propaganda can keep up with.
sentences.zh: 这些信息可能是为个别读者量身定制的，而且这一切都是实时进行的，速度之快，远远超过任何人类事实核查员或反宣传人员所能跟上的速度。

sentences.en: Well, all of that really makes me think,
sentences.zh: 这一切真的让我想起，

sentences.en: Kevin, about something that you wrote recently about chat, GPT, and a single line that I haven't been able to get out of my head in which you wrote, we are not ready.
sentences.zh: 凯文，你最近写过关于ChatGPT的文章，其中有一句话让我久久不能忘怀，你写道：我们还没有准备好。

sentences.en: We're not ready for this.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有为这个做好准备。

sentences.en: And I can see, based on everything you're saying, why we aren't.
sentences.zh: 根据你所说的一切，我能理解为什么我们还没有准备好。

sentences.en: But since you've spent so much time studying all this, do you think that there are ways that the institutions in our world or we as individuals
sentences.zh: 但既然你花了那么多时间研究所有这些，你认为我们世界的各种机构，或者我们作为个人，有没有什么办法

sentences.en: can get ourselves ready for the power of this new technology or readier than perhaps we'd be if we didn't give it some thought?
sentences.zh: 能让自己为这种新技术的威力做好准备？或者说，比我们不加思索时准备得更充分一些？

sentences.en: I mean, look at how much something like Twitter has changed our society, our culture, our political climate, our elections.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看像推特这样的东西在多大程度上改变了我们的社会、我们的文化、我们的政治气候、我们的选举。

sentences.en: And Twitter is just a text box.
sentences.zh: 而推特只是一个文本框。

sentences.en: It's dumb.
sentences.zh: 它很蠢。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: It's just a bunch of people being stupid.
sentences.zh: 它只是一群人在那里犯傻。

sentences.en: You type in words and you send them to other people.
sentences.zh: 你输入文字，然后把它们发给其他人。

sentences.en: And that seems like very prosaic technology compared to what's coming out of these AI research institutions and companies.
sentences.zh: 与这些人工智能研究机构和公司即将推出的成果相比，这似乎是非常平淡的技术。

sentences.en: And so it just feels like we are just staring at this technology that is rapidly approaching our society and we're not even quite sure what it is yet.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉我们就像是在注视着这项正迅速向我们社会逼近的技术，甚至还不完全清楚它到底是什么。

sentences.en: To say nothing of how we are supposed to coexist with it peacefully and in a way that doesn't break our society.
sentences.zh: 更不用说我们该如何与它和平共处，且不破坏我们的社会了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how are we supposed to be ready to coexist with it?
sentences.zh: 我们究竟该如何准备好与它共存？

sentences.en: I mean, are there actually things we could do?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的有什么我们可以做的事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think one obvious, maybe too obvious thing is just to use it, to try it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为一个显而易见、也许过于显而易见的事情就是去使用它，去尝试它。

sentences.en: I learned more from spending a couple hours playing around with ChatGPT about this field of AI and
sentences.zh: 我花了两几个小时玩ChatGPT，从中学到的关于人工智能这个领域、

sentences.en: where it is and what its limitations are and what it's really good at than I would have by reading a dozen articles about it.
sentences.zh: 它目前的发展阶段、它的局限性以及它到底擅长什么，要比我读十几篇关于它的文章学到的还要多。

sentences.en: So I think that's one thing that people can do is just get in there and start playing around with it yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为人们可以做的一件事就是直接去接触它，然后自己开始玩起来。

sentences.en: I think the other thing we have to do is just to have conversations like this one, frankly, where, you know, we talk about both the promise and the pitfalls of
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须做的另一件事，坦白说，就是进行像今天这样的对话，你知道的，我们既谈论这些新技术的承诺，也谈论它们的陷阱，

sentences.en: these new technologies and really keep the pressure on the companies who make these tools to make them
sentences.zh: 并真正向制造这些工具的公司施加压力，要求它们尽可能负责任、

sentences.en: as responsibly and thoughtfully as they can, not cutting corners or just racing to be the first to market with some, you know, new AI model.
sentences.zh: 深思熟虑地开发这些工具，而不是偷工减料，或者仅仅为了争当某个你知道的新人工智能模型的市场第一而盲目竞赛。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that in a few years, this technology, whether it's from open AI or Google or someone else, will be embedded in products and apps that billions of people use every day.
sentences.zh: 我认为在几年内，这项技术，无论是来自OpenAI、谷歌还是其他任何人，都将嵌入到数十亿人每天使用的产品和应用程序中。

sentences.en: And that makes this a really important time to have these conversations solutions to figure out what the limits of these models should be, what they should and shouldn't do,
sentences.zh: 这使得现在成为进行这些对话的极其重要的时期，我们需要找出这些模型的局限性应该在哪里，它们应该做什么和不应该做什么，

sentences.en: because pretty soon they're going to be a lot harder to control.
sentences.zh: 因为很快它们将变得更加难以控制。

sentences.en: Well, Kevin, normally I would thank you in my very Michael Robarro way, but instead I've asked
sentences.zh: 好吧，凯文，通常我会以我极具迈克尔·巴尔巴罗（Michael Barbaro）特色的方式感谢你，但相反，我请

sentences.en: ChatGPT to write me a goodbye to Kevin Roos on this episode of The Daily, and I'm going to read the answer.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT为我在这期《每日新闻》节目中写一段向凯文·罗斯（Kevin Roose）道别的致辞，我要把这段回答读出来。

sentences.en: Dear Kevin, we are sorry to see you go, but we are grateful for the time that you have spent with us on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的凯文，我们很遗憾看到你离开，但我们感谢你陪伴《每日新闻》度过的时光。

sentences.en: Your insights and perspectives have added so much to our show, and we've enjoyed getting to know you.
sentences.zh: 你的见解和视角为我们的节目增色不少，我们很高兴能认识你。

sentences.en: We wish you the best in your future endeavors.
sentences.zh: 我们祝你在未来的努力中一切顺利。

sentences.en: Thank you for everything, and goodbye.
sentences.zh: 感谢你所做的一切，再见。

sentences.en: Sincerely, The Daily Team.
sentences.zh: 诚挚的，《每日新闻》团队。

sentences.en: Wow, that's really touching.
sentences.zh: 哇，这真的很感人。

sentences.en: I'm really, I am really moved that you outsourced your goodbye to a robot.
sentences.zh: 我真的很，我真的很感动，你竟然把道别外包给了一个机器人。

sentences.en: I am frantically trying to use ChatGPT to generate a response to you, but it's giving me an error message and telling me that the system is too busy right now.
sentences.zh: 我正在疯狂地试图用ChatGPT来生成一段回复你的话，但它一直在报错，并告诉我系统现在太忙了。

sentences.en: So I will just have to use my frail, fallible human language skills to say, thank you, it's great to be here, and happy holidays.
sentences.zh: 所以我只能用我脆弱、容易出错的人类语言技巧来说：谢谢你，很高兴来到这里，祝大家节日快乐。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
